title: M/s Abacus India Agencies Pvt. Ltd. v. U.P. Power Corporation Ltd.
coram: Shekhar B. Saraf and Manjive Shukla, JJ.
disposition: Writ disposed of as withdrawn with liberty to apply under Clause 6.5.
headnote: After argument the petitioner withdrew the writ seeking liberty to apply under Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. The Division Bench disposed of the petition with that liberty and did not decide the supply dispute on merits.
facts: M/s Abacus India Agencies Pvt. Ltd., through its authorised signatory Mr. Imtiyaz Ansari, filed a writ petition in the Lucknow Bench of the Allahabad High Court against U.P. Power Corporation Ltd. and two others. After counsel were heard and argument had proceeded at some length, the petitioner sought to withdraw the writ, asking instead for liberty to make an application under Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. The Division Bench recorded that request and did not decide the underlying electricity dispute on merits.

holding_units.holding: A writ against the licensee may be disposed of as withdrawn with liberty to the petitioner to file an application under Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005; the Court does not then decide the supply dispute on merits.
